features.feature: sessionId: stable per-session identity (local process-coordination only)
owner-lease.json records sessionId/hostname/pid/cwd/command/acquiredAt/heartbeatAt/optional human label
First story-scoped mutating command acquires the owner lease
Owner commands refresh heartbeatAt
Lease released when story reaches DONE/DISCARDED and cleanup succeeds
owner-lease.json is process metadata, visible in session_brief but not verification evidence
owner-lease.json must not leave uncommitted dirty writes before DONE (F-008 class)
Non-owner story-scoped mutating commands fail closed with owner guidance
Read-only commands (session_brief/story_get/checklist_get/finding_list/...) never require a lease
Command classification table: every command classified readOnly/storyScopedMutating/reviewerWrite/mainSharedMutating/dangerousMutating
No missing commands in classification, no wrongly-blocked read-only commands
Contract test: every registered command has an ownershipClass, absence fails test
Reviewer writes (finding_add/review_pass_set) NOT gated by main-agent owner lease (lane-scoped exception)
Reviewer writes still record actor/session
finding_resolve/finding_dismiss owner-gated for normal story; B-META findings go mainSharedMutating (main write lock, not owner lease)
validate --story=B-xxx owner-gated; diagnostic validate without --story does not require owner lease
delivery_check_set as reviewerWrite only when actor/lane=delivery reviewer; otherwise storyScopedMutating or rejected
Unclassified commands fail-closed (not default-allow)
Stale lease detection: heartbeatAt older than 30 minutes without refresh
--takeover transfers a STALE lease to current session and records a takeover event
Non-stale (active) lease requires explicit --forceTakeover (treated as human-approved)
Without --takeover/--forceTakeover no lease is transferred; takeover recorded as dangerous-mutating event
Error UX: non-owner mutation error states which story is owned, owner sessionId/cwd/last-heartbeat age, whether lease is stale, allowed next action
session_brief shows: story owner session, owner cwd, last heartbeat age, stale/active status, whether current session is owner, recommended action (proceed/read-only/takeover available/wait)
For B-META, session_brief shows shared audit state separately and must not suggest story_advance
owner lease does not block reviewer read-only flow (story_get/checklist_get/finding_list/session_brief)
doctor detects stale story owner leases and reports them
Acceptance Criteria 1: two sessions mutating same story — second rejected with owner guidance
Acceptance Criteria 2: two sessions working different stories — both proceed
Acceptance Criteria 5: stale lease takeover only with explicit takeover and event record
Acceptance Criteria 6: active lease takeover rejected unless forceTakeover/human-approved
Acceptance Criteria 7: session_brief clearly tells non-owner sessions to wait or stay read-only
Acceptance Criteria 8: existing read-only reviewer workflows still work
koala validate passes with new story-owner-lease smoke and command-ownership contract tests
Out of scope: cryptographic identity / unforgeable agent identity
